lines: 安宁府，茶马道。
短打衣衫的半大孩童，背着与他差不多高的大竹篓，费力用行山杖拨开密密草丛。
茶马道的龙背岭，出了名的猛恶。
可谓林莽森然，天光绝迹，虬龙般的古木参天，像乌云遮蔽日头。
就连杂草都长得老高，好似带着锯齿。
幸亏小陆沉机灵，知道学着有经验的采药客，跟山郎。
用粗布缠着胳膊，穿草鞋的双脚打着绑腿。
不然走在山林里，手脚很容易被割出一条条血印子。
再受烈日暴晒，又疼又痒，若忍不住抓伤，发炎流脓那就坏透了。
搞不好有性命之危！
“发炎？”
年仅十二岁的陆沉挠挠头，他也不知道脑袋里为啥冒出这个生词。
反正前阵子生一场大病，陆沉小脑袋瓜便凭空多出大量杂乱记忆。
诸如“河水要烧开喝，否则遭病，肚里长虫”
之类。
很莫名其妙。
“千万不能让别个晓得。”
小陆沉暗暗提醒自己。
他曾听替大商行收药材的沈老汉讲过，这种情况叫“中邪”
或者“撞祟”
身上染着脏东西，要被拖到庙里关起来。
如果治不好，下场更惨。
这几天，小陆沉老做噩梦，梦见自己不小心暴露秘密，让府衙的官差捉走，五花大绑到菜市口，装进瓮里活活烧死。
沙沙！
一阵风吹过，这会儿暑气大盛，哪怕山风都夹杂酷热之意。
小陆沉抹了把额头汗珠，他那身短打麻衣，早已被浸湿。
他气喘吁吁，心里琢磨着：
“还有两个时辰天就黑了，今天没收获的话，赊欠的药钱，就要涨利息……必须想办法弄个好货！”
之前小陆沉生病卧床，烧得迷迷糊糊，是隔壁干杂事的张大娘，替自己寻来郎中。
茶马道最大的行当之一，便是药材铺。
这里从不缺好药，就是只剩半口气，半只脚踏进鬼门关，也能救回一时半刻。
但好药须得大钱，小陆沉打小便过着温饱线挣扎的苦日子，翻遍家里也找不到几颗多余铜板。
他只吃了几副药汤，便欠着回春堂五百八十多文钱。
“大宗的药材，像云茯苓，当归这些，须得论斤成捆，几株卖不上价。
得是冬虫夏草，龙血竭才能解燃眉之急。”
小陆沉有点发愁，他年纪太小，没有人愿意带着拖油瓶进山，只能采些常见药草，每日换个十几文钱勉强糊口。
“再过四五天，五百八十文就要滚成好几千文，哪里还得上，只能签卖身契，把自己押给回春堂……”
小陆沉想想就害怕，做回春堂的采药郎，可不是啥好差事儿。
每每赶山大会，都得如牛羊一样，成群结队被驱使着。
content_en:
Anning Mansion, Tea Horse Road.
A half-year-old child in short jackets, carrying a large bamboo basket about the same height as himself, struggled to push through the dense grass with a hiking stick.
Longbeiling on the Tea Horse Road is notoriously vicious.
It can be said that the forest is dense, the skylight is extinct, and the ancient trees like horny dragons are towering into the sky, like dark clouds covering the sun.
Even the weeds grew tall and seemed to have jagged edges.
Fortunately, Xiao Lu Shen was smart and knew how to imitate experienced herb collectors and Shanlang.
His arms were wrapped in coarse cloth, and his feet in straw sandals were tied with leggings.
Otherwise, when walking in the mountains and forests, your hands and feet will easily get bloody marks.
If you are exposed to the scorching sun again, it will hurt and itch. If you can't help but scratch it, it will become inflamed and pus will flow, which will be really bad.
Maybe his life is in danger!
"Inflammation?"
Lu Chen, who was only twelve years old, scratched his head. He didn't know why this new word came into his head.
Anyway, he had a serious illness a while ago, and a lot of messy memories appeared in Lu Chen's little head out of thin air.
Such as "The river water must be boiled to drink, otherwise you will get sick and have worms in your belly."
and so on.
Very baffling.
"Don't let anyone else know."
Xiao Luchen reminded himself secretly.
He once heard Old Man Shen, who collects medicinal materials for a large trading company, say that this situation is called "being possessed by evil spirits."
Or "collision"
If your body is stained with dirt, you will be dragged to the temple and locked up.
If it cannot be cured, the consequences will be even worse.
In the past few days, Xiao Lu Shen Lao had nightmares, dreaming that he accidentally exposed his secret and was captured by government officials. He was tied to the entrance of the vegetable market, put in an urn and burned alive.
rustle!
A gust of wind blew by, and the heat was now in full swing. Even the mountain breeze was filled with intense heat.
Xiao Luchen wiped the sweat from his forehead. His short linen clothes were already soaked.
He was panting and thinking:
"It will be dark in two hours. If there is no harvest today, the interest on the medicine owed on credit will increase... We must find a way to get a good product!"
Previously, Xiao Luchen was ill and bedridden, suffering from a fever. Aunt Zhang, who worked as a chore next door, found a doctor for him.
One of the biggest businesses on the Tea Horse Road is the medicine shop.
There is no shortage of good medicine here. Even if you only have half a breath left and half a foot in the gate of hell, you can still save a moment.
But good medicine requires a lot of money. Xiao Lu Shen lived a miserable life struggling to make ends meet. He searched his house but couldn't find a few extra copper coins.
He only took a few medicinal decoctions and still owed Huichun Hall more than 580 yuan.
"Bulks of medicinal materials, such as Poria cocos and Angelica sinensis, must be packed into bundles by kilograms, and a few plants cannot be sold at high prices.
Only cordyceps and dragon's blood can solve the urgent problem. "
Little Lu Chen was a little worried. He was too young and no one was willing to carry an oil bottle into the mountains. He could only collect some common herbs and earn a living for more than ten cents a day.
"In four or five days, the five hundred and eighty yuan will be rolled into thousands of yuan. There is no way to pay for it. I can only sign a deed of betrayal and surrender myself to the Huichun Hall..."
Little Lu Chen was scared when he thought about it. Being a herb collector at Huichun Hall was not a good job.
Every time there is a mountain gathering, they are driven in groups like cattle and sheep.
